candidate_name: Damerjog LNG export terminal (DDID master-plan long-term phase)
sponsor_or_proposer: Djibouti Damerjog Industrial Development FZ (DPFZA); no gas supplier/sponsor since POLY-GCL exit
current_state: Residual master-plan placeholder only. Ethiopia officially terminated the Ogaden gas export/LNG scheme in June 2025 (GEM record Djibouti FLNG Terminal T100000130667 = cancelled). DPFZA's DDID page still lists 'a LNG export terminal' in the long-term phase, with no timeline, sponsor, or gas source; current DDID financing (Afreximbank/BCIMR ~$155M) covers oil tank farm/jetty/power, not LNG.
missing_threshold_elements: No sponsor, no gas supply source, no concrete step (no MOU, permit, or charter) since the 2025 cancellation.
watch_for: Any new sponsor or gas-supply agreement for a Damerjog LNG berth (e.g., a revived Ethiopia deal or third-party FSU/FLNG); if a materially different sponsor/design appears, stage as a NEW terminal with AssociatedTerminals → T100000130667 per the dead-and-revived rule.
notes: Revival check on the dormant_revival_watch item found no 2025-2026 activity; the only 'signs of life' article (Africa Briefing) dates from ~2017. dedup_index: update_dead_and_revived vs Djibouti FLNG Terminal (0.0 km) — same site, currently no distinct project → monitor, not new_terminal.
